text:
Nora: Thinking about a tiny LAN Friday evening in the common area — 6pm? I can bring my PS5 and two DualSense. Anyone up for some couch co-op + Rocket League/Overcooked mashup? :party_parrot:
Sam: 6pm works. I’ll bring a power strip and a travel Wi‑Fi router. Also have a spare ethernet cable.
Lucas: I can bring my gaming laptop + extra Xbox controller (bluetooth). Might try some Rocket League ranked if people want.
Riley: I have a Switch + Mario Kart. Need a dock though — can someone bring an HDMI switch?
Maya: Quick FYI: Steam Family Sharing won't let two people play the same shared game at the same time. Also VAC games like CSGO can't be family-shared.
Jamie: Good call. Maybe we avoid shared single-player titles. Local co-op or different accounts is safest.
Nora: @Maya thanks — hadn't thought about VAC. We'll make a list of who brings what. Also snacks? chips + soda?
Sam: Snacks: I can pick up crisps and some sparkling water. Any dietary stuff? @Lucas are you vegan?
Lucas: Yep vegan — thanks for checking. I'll bring some hummus + pita.
Riley: I can bring an HDMI switch and a small surge-protected power strip (just in case). :thumbsup:
CalendarBot: Event created: "Friday LAN @ Common Area" — 2026-04-10 18:00 — RSVP thread: https://calendar.local/events/12345
Maya: Quick logistics: please label controllers with names, and if borrowing please return same day. Also please disinfect controllers between users.
Jamie: Also reminder: no external accounts that might trigger anti-cheat on others' machines. Keep installs offline-friendly.
Nora: Awesome — I'll post a small sign-up sheet in the channel tomorrow. If anyone needs to borrow a controller PM me. :smiley:
Sam: Count me in. See y'all Friday! :rocket:
